arStrings.szText: {c_important}Chain Lightning{/c} gains {c_number}[{SF_42}*100|%+|]{/c} Cast Speed and its number of chains is doubled.

{c_important}Chain Lightning{/c} alternates between chaining to an enemy and to you. When it chains to you, it gains {c_number}[{SF_51}*100|%x|]{/c} increased damage, up to {c_number}[{SF_55}*100|%x|]{/c}, and does not use a chain.

{c_important}Chain Lightning{/c} becomes a {c_important}Frost{/c} Skill that deals Cold damage.

{c_important}Chain Lightning{/c} {c_important}{u}Chills{/u}{/c} by {c_number}[SF_37|%|]{/c} and deals up to {c_number}[100|%x|]{/c} increased damage based on how {c_important}{u}Chilled{/u}{/c} the enemy is, dealing the maximum damage if they are {c_important}{u}Frozen{/u}{/c}.
{c_important}Chain Lightning{/c} deals {c_number}[{SF_45}*100|x%|]{/c} increased damage to the first enemy hit.

Every Second, {c_important}{u}Chain Lightning{/c}{/u} gains {c_number}[SF_47*100|%x|]{/c} damage, up to {c_number}[SF_47*SF_14*100|%x|]{/c}. This bonus is reset when you damage an enemy with a Skill Cast other than {c_important}Chain Lightning{/c}.

{c_important}Chain Lightning{/c} forms a {c_important}{u}Crackling Energy{/c}{/u} whenever it Critically Strikes.

{c_important}Chain Lightning{/c} gains {c_number}[{SF_53}*100|%+|]{/c} Critical Strike Chance.
